label: SYNTHETIC
note: The priority routing member of the fintech pack (PCK-09; ruling A644, interim, relayed, not yet committed). It maps each SLA phase the pack names (predicate_variables.sla_phase) to a priority (HIGH, NORMAL or LOW) and the owner queue the case goes to (a queue in routing_allowlist). A phase with no entry is NORMAL. Every value is SYNTHETIC and is not a Founder-approved routing policy; the Founders set the real values (AGENT-16). Pack data (SoT 51).
